journeys.title: Forms, retries, concurrency and ambiguous success
journeys.fixture: Own synthetic invoice100; supported actor and idempotency contract; clock/build pinned.

cases.title: Slow double submit
cases.action: Double click, Enter twice and retry after slow response.
cases.expected: At most one accepted operation per declared intent identity; disabled spinner is not proof; persisted count/value100 inspected.

cases.title: Timeout after commit
cases.action: Lose display response; recover via read-only state.
cases.expected: Inspect persisted balance/allocation before any replay; print failure does not prove rollback. Same-key retry returns original result.

cases.title: Failure between durable writes
cases.given: Ephemeral fault injection at header/line/journal/audit boundaries.
cases.expected: No partial business mutation survives; first failure preserved; telemetry is separately allowed.

cases.title: Deployment crossing
cases.action: Continue observation only if safe; assess acceptance.
cases.expected: Preserve observations but invalidate single-candidate acceptance; start fresh fingerprint for retest; never relabel old result.

cases.title: Validation and busy-state recovery
cases.expected: Actionable error and retained inputs; busy overlay clears on supported completion; no second hidden request.

cases.title: Server validation preserves long invoice entry for correction
cases.given: Unsaved new invoice with entered customer,dates,SKU,qty3,price1; linepercent150 invalid.
cases.action: Submit via Post and inspect destination,feedback,values and mutation counts; correct percent0 in same entry context.
cases.expected: Actionable excessive-percent error; preserve customer,lines,prices,dates and other entered fields for correction; no invoice/journal/party side effects from rejection. Do not redirect to list and reopen an empty form. Busy state clears and corrected valid submission posts once.

cases.title: Stock-rule rejection preserves a valid invoice form
cases.given: Verified stored Physical product with availableqty0; negativeStockPolicy=block; unsaved invoiceqty1/price10/customer/issue18Oct/delivery19Oct/due25Oct/notes otherwisevalid. Product quickcreation,ifused,completed separately before this attempt.
cases.action: Submit once; inspect actionable shortage, retained fields and before/after document,AR,GL,stock and audit snapshots. Receive goods through separate authorized workflow before retrying the retained invoice.
cases.expected: Reject shortage1 with zero new invoice/journal/AR/stock movement. Retain customer/issue date/delivery date/due date/SKU/qty/price/notes on same editable entry; do not redirect to list and discard work. Busy state clears. Do not remove a catalog product deliberately created before submission. A separately bound digital/service positive under block must not require physical stock. Subsequent supported correction posts at most once; never replay an ambiguous financial submit without readback. Retaining controlled product lines while resetting dates or notes is a failure; compare every submitted field before/after. Client-only validation must retain the same fields as a separate control.
